alerts.text: Unfortunately, I have not had much time or interest to work on TS4-related projects lately. As such, my mods have not been tested since September 2025, so use them at your own risk. Please report any issues you encounter with my mods on Discord.
As of December 31, 2025, no known game-breaking issues have been reported for any of my mods. This is NOT a guarantee that they work 100% as expected.
Keep an eye on my website, Discord, and Bluesky for future announcements.
